findings.title: Local template preview server concatenates raw URL into filesystem path
findings.description: The developer-only template preview server builds a filesystem path by concatenating the raw request URL onto a base directory without normalization or containment. A request URL containing traversal segments resolves outside the intended template directory, disclosing arbitrary files readable by the server process.
findings.impact: An attacker with network reach to the dev preview host can read files outside the template directory on the developer's machine.
findings.exploit_scenario: A developer runs the dev-only preview server. An attacker on the same network requests a URL with ../ segments, and the server returns a file outside the template root.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the requested path against the template root and reject any resolved path that escapes it; bind the preview server to localhost only.
preconditions: A developer is running the dev-only preview server.
The attacker has network reachability to the dev host on port 3000.
